# foundry_dataset (Data Source)

Looks up a dataset version by name. When `version` is omitted, the service's current latest version is returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foundry_dataset" "knowledge" {
  name = "knowledge"
}

output "knowledge_dataset_version" {
  value = data.foundry_dataset.knowledge.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the dataset to look up.

### Optional

- `version` (String) Version of the dataset. Omit to resolve the service's current latest version.

### Read-Only

- `connection_name` (String) Azure Storage connection associated with the dataset, when present.
- `data_uri` (String) URI of the dataset file or folder.
- `description` (String) Description returned for the dataset version, when present.
- `id` (String) Service-assigned dataset asset identifier.
- `is_reference` (Boolean) Whether the dataset references external storage.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags returned for the dataset version, when present.
- `type` (String) Dataset type, `uri_file` or `uri_folder`.
